note: Officer-facing words for the result page: what to do next with this customer, and the customer-history policy checks (app/config/customer_history_policy.yaml, keyed by rule id; the id itself is never shown). Placeholders: {ref} Customer ID, {what} the searched identifier, {failed} the failed checks.

reasons.THRESHOLD_UNCONFIGURED: Not checked: the business has not set this limit yet.
reasons.DATA_UNAVAILABLE: Not checked: the data this check needs is not available or not verified.
reasons.EVALUATION_FAILED: Not checked: the value could not be compared.

H01_SOURCE_AVAILABLE.title: MIFIN responded
H01_SOURCE_AVAILABLE.what: Checks that MIFIN gave a proper answer for this customer.

H02_IDENTITY_RESOLVED.title: Customer identity confirmed
H02_IDENTITY_RESOLVED.what: Checks that MIFIN confirmed this is the same customer, not just a possible match.

H03_HISTORY_COMPLETE.title: Loan history complete
H03_HISTORY_COMPLETE.what: Checks that the status of every earlier loan is known from Leviosa.

H04_NO_CONFLICTING_RECORDS.title: No conflicting loan records
H04_NO_CONFLICTING_RECORDS.what: Checks that the same loan does not appear twice with different details.

H05_NO_UNKNOWN_LOAN_STATUS.title: All loan statuses known
H05_NO_UNKNOWN_LOAN_STATUS.what: Checks that no earlier loan has an unknown status.

H06_ADVERSE_HISTORY.title: No settled or written-off loan
H06_ADVERSE_HISTORY.what: Checks that no earlier loan was settled or written off.

H07_EXISTING_LOAN_COUNT.title: Running loans within limit
H07_EXISTING_LOAN_COUNT.what: Checks the number of running loans against the allowed limit.

H08_TOTAL_EXPOSURE.title: Total exposure within limit
H08_TOTAL_EXPOSURE.what: Checks the amount still owed plus this loan against the allowed limit.

H09_EMI_BURDEN.title: EMI burden within limit
H09_EMI_BURDEN.what: Checks the existing monthly EMIs against the allowed limit.

H10_DPD.title: Repayment delays within limit
H10_DPD.what: Checks the longest payment delay (DPD) in the last 12 months against the allowed limit.

H11_TOPUP_ELIGIBILITY.title: Running loans meet the top-up conditions
H11_TOPUP_ELIGIBILITY.what: Months since disbursal, repayment delays and the share still outstanding, for every running loan.

H12_EMI_BOUNCES.title: EMI bounces within limit
H12_EMI_BOUNCES.what: EMIs bounced in the last 12 months, from Leviosa.

H13_FRAUD_HISTORY.title: No open or confirmed fraud case
H13_FRAUD_HISTORY.what: RCU / fraud cases on the customer.

H14_COLLATERAL_REUSE.title: Property not pledged by another customer
H14_COLLATERAL_REUSE.what: The customer's pledged properties in the collateral registry.

UNKNOWN.title: Could not check this customer
UNKNOWN.text: MIFIN did not answer, so we cannot tell if this is an existing customer. Run the check again before going ahead.

AMBIGUOUS.title: More than one customer matched
AMBIGUOUS.text: This {what} matches more than one customer in MIFIN. Check the KYC documents with operations and pick the right customer before going ahead.

POSSIBLE_EXISTING.title: Confirm the customer first
POSSIBLE_EXISTING.text: This may be an existing customer ({ref}), but it is not confirmed. Match the name, date of birth and PAN with the customer's documents. Only then link the case and use the loan history.

EXISTING_FAILED.title: Existing customer – check before sending to credit
EXISTING_FAILED.text: Existing SBFC customer ({ref}). Found: {failed}. Resolve them, or note your reason, before sending the case to credit.

EXISTING_CLEAN.title: Existing customer – history is clean
EXISTING_CLEAN.text: Existing SBFC customer ({ref}). No loan history check failed. Link this case to the customer and send it to credit.

DECLARED_EXISTING_NOT_FOUND.title: Marked Existing, but no record found
DECLARED_EXISTING_NOT_FOUND.text: No SBFC customer has this {what}. Check that the {what} was typed correctly; if it is right, change the customer type to New and continue.

NEW_OTHER_CASES.title: New customer, but seen in other cases
NEW_OTHER_CASES.text: No earlier SBFC loan, but other cases in the LOS have this {what}. Check those cases are the same person before going ahead.

NEW.title: New customer – continue onboarding
NEW.text: No earlier SBFC customer or loan has this {what}. Continue as a new customer.

next.DECLARED_NEW_BUT_FOUND: This customer was marked New but already has an SBFC record. Change the customer type to Existing.

EXISTING_OTHER_RECORDS.title: Existing customer – check the other records first
EXISTING_OTHER_RECORDS.text: Existing SBFC customer ({ref}) and the loan history is clean, but other records need a look: {review}. Check them, then send the case to credit.

NEW_REVIEW.title: New customer – check the other records first
NEW_REVIEW.text: No earlier SBFC loan, but other records need a look: {review}. Check them before going ahead.

CHECK_INCOMPLETE.title: Check incomplete – do not decide yet
CHECK_INCOMPLETE.text: Some searches did not run ({missing}), so the result is not complete. Run the check again before going ahead.

business_rules_note: The business's dedupe rules R01-R11, shown on the result page. Each rule is built from what the answer really carries: loan-history checks (history, by rule id), LOS dedupe scenarios (scenario), the LOS search for the entered identifier (los_search) and whether MIFIN's PAN / mobile equals the searched one (identifier). A rule with no parts is not implemented and says which source it needs.

scheme_labels_note: MIFIN SCHEME code -> a friendly product name. EMPTY until the business confirms each meaning (e.g. what 'ME' stands for); an unmapped scheme is shown exactly as MIFIN sends it.
form_layout_note: The create form's sections and order (like the LOS Sourcing screen's Application Details). '@' entries are the page's own controls (codes, customer type, dedupe parameter / value, loan tenure in years -> tenure_months x 12). With no 'loan' section, a backend field not listed goes to Application Details, so a new field never disappears; the Loan Details card shows only if a 'loan' section is listed again.

questions.customer: Is this person already our customer?
questions.loans: Have they taken loans from us before?
questions.pan: Is the PAN the same as in our records?
questions.duplicate: Is the same person applying twice right now?

customer.POTENTIAL_MATCH: Maybe. MIFIN found someone who looks similar. Please confirm it is the same person.
customer.AMBIGUOUS: Not sure. More than one customer looks similar.
customer.NO_MATCH: No. This is a new customer.
customer.UNKNOWN: We could not check. MIFIN did not answer.

loans.NOT_ATTRIBUTED: Hidden until you confirm it is the same customer.
loans.UNKNOWN: We don't know. The loan system did not answer.

pan.MATCH: Yes. The same PAN is on all {n} loan(s).
pan.MATCH_NO_LOANS: Yes. It is the same PAN.
pan.MISMATCH: No! The PAN is different. Please check carefully.
pan.NOT_COMPARED: Not checked. This case has no PAN yet.

duplicate.CONFIRMED: Yes. This is a duplicate. Stop.
duplicate.POSSIBLE: Maybe. Another application looks the same. Please check it.
duplicate.UNKNOWN: Not sure. The check could not finish.
duplicate.NOT_EVALUATED: Not needed. They are a new customer.

decision.PROCEED_TO_NEXT_STAGE: Go ahead. Nothing here stops this application.
decision.HOLD_FOR_REVIEW: Wait. Someone must check it first.
decision.BLOCK_APPLICATION: Stop. This application cannot go on.
decision.UNABLE_TO_DECIDE: Ask your manager. There is no rule for this yet.
